title: South Congress Austin Food Tour
blurb: Experience the heart and personality of Austin on this guided food tour through South Congress (SoCo), one of the city's most iconic and energetic neighborhoods. Combining delicious local flavors with Austin's famous creative spirit, this tour takes travelers beyond the typical sightseeing experience and into the culture that makes SoCo a must-visit destination. Sample Austin favorites such as tacos, BBQ, food truck specialties, sweet treats, and local beverages while discovering colorful murals, quirky shops, historic landmarks, and the unmistakable "Keep Austin Weird" atmosphere. With a local guide leading the way, you'll enjoy an easy-paced walking experience that blends great food, local stories, street culture, and authentic Austin character, making it ideal for first-time visitors, couples, solo travelers, families, and small groups.
